This is a known nvm-windows limitation with old Node versions: nvm-windows downloads the npm distribution for the Node version it installs, and for EOL versions like 14.17.3 the npm archive path has moved, so the npm zip 404s and the install aborts with 'npm file not found'. Workarounds: install a newer Node version, or manually place npm into the version's directory (AppData\Roaming
vm\v14.17.3
ode_modules
pm) from npm's own distribution, or use a Node version manager that fetches npm separately.

iOS Safari's collapsing address bar changes the visual viewport height as you scroll, and fixed/sticky elements anchored to the layout viewport shift when it does. The remedy is to anchor against the visual viewport: listen to visualViewport resize/scroll and reposition, or use CSS that tolerates the changing height (avoid anchoring to 100vh/100% of a viewport that changes; use dvh/svh units where the layout allows).

The 404 'models/gemini-1.5-flash is not found for API version v1beta' means the model id is no longer served on that API version: Google deprecated gemini-1.5-flash. Remedy: call ListModels to see the ids your key still serves, switch to a current model name, or pin the API version that still serves 1.5-flash if you must keep it.

Tailwind CSS v4 removed the standalone `tailwindcss` CLI executable that v3 had, so `npx tailwindcss init -p` cannot resolve an executable. In v4 there is no tailwind.config.js by default: configuration lives in CSS (@import "tailwindcss") and the build plugins. Remedy: use @tailwindcss/vite (or @tailwindcss/postcss) and configure via CSS; if you need the v3-style CLI, install tailwindcss@3 instead.

Same cause as the identical error in other v4 projects: Tailwind v4 has no `tailwindcss` CLI executable, so `npx tailwindcss init -p` fails with 'could not determine executable to run'. With v4, install @tailwindcss/vite and write the config in CSS (@import "tailwindcss"); drop the `npx tailwindcss init` step entirely.

In Tailwind v4 there is no tailwind.config.js by default; configuration is CSS. The container and its breakpoints are theme variables (--container-* under @theme), and custom responsive/hover utilities are declared with @utility. So: set the container max-width after the xl breakpoint via the container theme variables in your CSS, and add custom classes with @utility (e.g. @utility card { ... }) which respond to hover: and responsive: variants like built-in utilities.

DBeaver is asking Maven for the literal version string 'RELEASE', which no repository serves, so the driver artifact cannot resolve. Remedy: in DBeaver's Driver Manager, open the PostgreSQL driver's settings and set the artifact version to a concrete released version (or clear the 'RELEASE' placeholder), or add the PostgreSQL JDBC driver jar manually under the driver's Libraries.

The warning is Google Play's target-API requirement: new apps and updates must target Android 15 (API 35). In Buildozer set android.api = 35 — that is the targetSdkVersion. android.sdk = 34 can stay (it is the SDK platform/build tooling), though raising it to 35 also works; android.minapi = 21 can stay. Only android.api needs to change to clear the warning.

This is a known TypeScript-server false positive on side-effect CSS imports in fresh Next.js projects (ts(2882) on `import './globals.css'`). Remedy: restart the TS server (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P, 'TypeScript: Restart TS Server'); if it persists, align Next.js and TypeScript versions or set "moduleResolution": "bundler" in tsconfig.json. The CSS import itself is correct for Next.js.

Those at-rules (@theme, @utility, @apply, @source, @reference, @variant, @custom-variant, @plugin) are Tailwind CSS v4 syntax: valid to the Tailwind processor at build time, but unknown to the plain CSS language service, which flags every one as 'unknown at rule'. Remedy: install the Tailwind CSS v4 editor extension for VS Code so the language service knows the at-rules; the build itself is fine via @tailwindcss/vite or @tailwindcss/postcss.

An editable install only exposes what the build backend declares as the project's packages. In a layout where config/ and packages/src/ are not the project's own package root, a bare `uv pip install -e .` installs only the project itself. Remedy: declare the local packages as editable path dependencies in [tool.uv.sources] (e.g. my-pkg = { path = "packages/src/my-pkg", editable = true }), or configure the build backend's package discovery so those directories are included.

Spring Boot 4 restructured the spring-boot-test-autoconfigure module, and @AutoConfigureMockMvc moved out of the Boot 3 package (org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet). I do not know the exact new package from general knowledge; the resolution is the Spring Boot 4.0 migration guide, which names the new location of the test autoconfiguration classes, plus the correct starter dependency.

uv resolves the pinned `python==3.9.21` only against interpreters it can find; 3.9.21 is not installed, so it falls back to 3.13.2 and sync refuses. Remedy: `uv python install 3.9.21`, then `uv init --package --python 3.9.21` (or point --python at the installed interpreter's path), then `uv sync`.

VS Code 1.97+ opens .svg with the built-in image preview. To view/edit the SVG as text: right-click the file, 'Open With…' → Text Editor (or 'Reopen in Text Editor'). To make it permanent, change the default editor association for svg in Settings (workbench.editorAssociations: remove the svg → image preview entry, or set it to Text Editor).

Bind a key to the Copilot Chat view command: open Keyboard Shortcuts (Ctrl+K Ctrl+S), search 'Copilot Chat', and assign a shortcut to 'GitHub Copilot: Focus on Copilot Chat View' (or 'Open Copilot Chat'). To hide the panel again, bind the auxiliary-bar toggle (View → Appearance → Auxiliary Bar) or the command that closes the chat view, so one shortcut toggles.

iOS 26 applies the Liquid Glass design system-wide, and there is no public API to revert UITabBarController to the pre-iOS-18 appearance. The only supported way to keep the classic look is a custom tab bar: replace the UITabBarController's tab bar (or build a custom container) with a UIView styled to the classic appearance. No per-view opt-out API exists.

com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-full:6.0-2 is not on Maven Central, Maven's main repo, jcenter, or jitpack because the ffmpeg-kit artifacts were removed from those repositories. Remedy: add a repository that still hosts the artifact (the ffmpeg-kit project's own Maven repository, if still available) or vendor the AAR into your project; alternatively switch to a maintained fork or a different FFmpeg binding.

LangChain 1.0 restructured the package: the old langchain.chains module was removed/renamed, so `from langchain.chains import create_retrieval_chain` fails against langchain 1.0.5. The retrieval-chain builders moved to a different import path in the 1.0 package layout (the langchain package's new chain/retriever modules, or langchain-community). I do not know the exact 1.0 import path from general knowledge; the resolution is the LangChain 1.0 migration guide, which maps the old imports to the new ones.

The Tailwind CSS Intellisense extension predating v4 only understands the v3 setup (a tailwind.config.js) and does not activate on a v4 project, which has no config file by default. Remedy: update the extension to a release with Tailwind v4 support (v4 support landed in a 2025 update of the extension), which detects the @tailwindcss/vite setup and provides completions without a config file.

.github/copilot-instructions.md is read by Copilot in VS Code and on github.com. The JetBrains plugin does not read that file: in IntelliJ, Copilot custom instructions are configured per project in Settings → Tools → GitHub Copilot (the instructions field), not via the .github directory. So the file does not carry over to IntelliJ as-is.

The error means the Firebase Auth native module isn't registered with the Expo dev client. In Expo SDK 53 with the dev client, native modules must be autolinked — ensure firebase is in app.json plugins, that you're using expo-dev-client (not Expo Go), and that npx expo prebuild has been run so the native build includes the Auth module. Clear node_modules, ios/Pods (if applicable), and rebuild.

Bruno does not have a built-in console panel like Postman. Script output from pre-request and post-response scripts is not displayed in the UI. The workaround is to use the Collection Runner's results (which show pass/fail per request) or export results to a file. There is no dedicated console view in Bruno as of the current version.

The error means the PrismaClient constructor is being called without the required options object. With the prisma-client generator (engineType = 'client'), you must pass the datasource and other options explicitly: new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: process.env.DATABASE_URL }) or ensure the generated client is imported from the correct output path. The multi-schema setup (schema.prisma + schemaSA.prisma) requires separate generated clients for each output.

In Next.js 15, params is a Promise. You must unwrap it with React.use() before accessing properties: const { id } = React.use(params). Direct access to params.id throws the error you're seeing. This applies to both page.tsx and layout.tsx in dynamic routes.

This is a known issue with certain dotnet-ef package versions where the NuGet package is missing the DotnetToolSettings.xml file. Remedy: try a specific version (dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef --version 8.0.0 or 9.0.0), or install locally with dotnet tool install dotnet-ef --local, or use dotnet ef as a local tool via a tool manifest.

Xcode 26 requires the Metal Toolchain component to be downloaded separately. Run: xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain from the terminal, or open Xcode → Settings → Components and download it from there. After downloading, the metal compiler should be found.

The error means the @tailwindcss/vite plugin isn't being resolved. After upgrading Vite 5→6, ensure you've installed both tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/vite (npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite), added the plugin to vite.config.ts, and imported tailwind in your CSS (@import 'tailwindcss'). Also clear node_modules/.vite cache and restart the dev server.

The license field in pyproject.toml must use the SPDX license expression format (e.g., license = 'MIT') not the older table format. The 'license-file' field is deprecated in newer setuptools. Use: [project] license = 'MIT' or license = {text = 'MIT'}. Remove any license-file key.

This is the same nvm-windows EOL npm issue as other Node 14 versions. nvm-windows downloads the npm distribution for the Node version it installs, and for EOL versions like 14.21.3 the npm archive path has moved. Workarounds: install a newer Node version, manually place npm into the version's directory from npm's own distribution, or use a Node version manager that fetches npm separately.

The NDK version conflict means your plugins require a different NDK than your project specifies. In android/build.gradle, set android.ndkVersion = '27.0.12077973' to match the plugins' requirement, or downgrade the plugins to versions compatible with NDK 26.3.11579264. The project-level NDK version must satisfy all plugins.

PlaceAutocompleteElement renders its own input with Google's default styling. To match your form inputs, you need to style the shadow DOM parts the element exposes, or hide the built-in input and use the element's programmatic API to get place predictions, then render your own styled input that calls the element's methods. The element does not directly expose CSS custom properties for all styling.

Tomcat 9.0.106 introduced a change in multipart handling that limits the number of parts. The exception is likely related to maxParameterCount or a new multipart part limit. Check your server.xml's Connector configuration for maxPostSize and maxParameterCount, and check if there's a new maxParts or multipart config limit in 9.0.106. You may need to increase the limit or explicitly configure it.

std::hive is a proposed C++26 container that provides a stable-iterator container with O(1) insertion and deletion (no iterator invalidation on insert/erase). It's designed for scenarios where you need frequent insertions/deletations while maintaining iterator stability. The proposal is P3074. It is not yet in the standard — documentation will appear when it's ratified.

AGP 8.12.0 deprecated compileSdk in favor of a new DSL syntax. The replacement is compileSdk = 35 inside the android block, but the old syntax still works (deprecated, not removed). The strikethrough is a deprecation warning. You can suppress it by using the new syntax or ignore it — it will be removed in a future AGP version.

To disable Copilot code completion in Visual Studio: go to Tools → Options → GitHub Copilot → uncheck 'Enable Copilot' or set Completion to 'Disabled'. To turn off Copilot completely, uninstall the GitHub Copilot extension from Extensions → Manage Extensions. The behavior you're seeing (whole document replaced) is a known Copilot bug — disabling it restores regular IntelliSense.

The error means you're importing SafeAreaView from react-native (deprecated) instead of react-native-safe-area-context. Change the import from 'react-native' to 'react-native-safe-area-context': import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'. The react-native built-in SafeAreaView is deprecated on iOS.

The error means a stale .lock file exists from a crashed git process. Delete the lock file manually: rm .git/refs/remotes/origin/branchname.lock (or the full path from the error). Then run git gc --prune=now to clean up. If the lock file is in packed-refs, run git pack-refs --all first. This is safe — the lock file is only held during a git operation.

The error means your Flutter code uses deprecated edge-to-edge APIs. In recent Flutter versions, SystemChrome.setEnabledSystemUIMode(SystemUiMode.edgeToEdge) is deprecated. Use the new SystemUiOverlayStyle API or the SystemChrome.setSystemUIOverlayStyle method instead. Check the Flutter migration guide for the replacement API for your specific Flutter version.

The .slnx format documentation is in the .NET CLI docs: learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/tools/dotnet-sln. The format is fully supported as of .NET 9 SDK. The blog posts are the primary documentation — Microsoft hasn't moved it to learn.microsoft.com yet. You can convert with dotnet sln convert --format slnx.

This is the same iOS 26 Safari visualViewport bug as the other high-view thread. After dismissing the keyboard, the visualViewport's top is offset by 24px (the keyboard's inset). The workaround is to listen to visualViewport resize/scroll events and adjust, or use CSS that tolerates the changing viewport. This is a WebKit bug that Apple needs to fix.
